subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reactions first be exposed only as passive typed plugin events, or should the bundled plugin also persist them for historical message queries?
rationale: The two choices have different privacy, retention, access-control, agent-turn, and SQLite ownership consequences; source inspection cannot safely select the permanent user contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Passive events first
options.body: Expose add/remove reactions through the WhatsApp plugin without creating agent turns or durable history, then evaluate query storage separately.

options.title: Add durable queries now
options.body: Define a scoped SQLite reaction store, retention policy, and guarded query action in the same product decision.

options.title: Keep outbound-only reactions
options.body: Retain the present send-only behavior if maintainers do not want reaction feedback as a supported WhatsApp surface.

recommendation.title: Passive events first
recommendation.body: Expose add/remove reactions through the WhatsApp plugin without creating agent turns or durable history, then evaluate query storage separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history places this person closest to the current WhatsApp action and inbound implementation boundary.
